pages.text: In late Phase 6 a sealed room holds the only air. Breaking a wall or opening a door or trapdoor to vacuum $(danger)vents it in a burst$().

pages.title: What Seals
pages.text: Solid walls and full glass blocks seal, sunlight or not.$(br2)Fences, stairs, single slabs and leaves don't.

pages.title: Alarm
pages.text: A whoosh, a loud three-pulse alarm, and the ORSA voice: $(danger)WARNING: ATMOSPHERIC BREACH DETECTED$().$(br2)Particles point at the opening.

pages.title: Brace
pages.text: The pull lasts about $(bold)2 s$() and fades. Crouch on the ground to brace.$(br2)It can't pin you or pull you through walls.

pages.title: Flames
pages.text: Ordinary flames in the room go out together. Torches, wall ones too, become $(bold)Spent Torches$(); lanterns go dark; soul lights stay.$(br2)A vented room doesn't burst again per broken block.

pages.title: Without a Suit
pages.text: $(danger)Suffocation builds$() unless you wear full EVA with usable oxygen:$(li)1.5 s: lightheaded$(li)4 s: nausea, slowness$(li)7 s: severe slowness$(li)10 s on: $(danger)2 hearts/s$()
Tank O2 or an active Emergency EVA reserve keeps you breathing; empty or partial suits don't.$(br2)Cold hurts separately. A breach doesn't puncture the suit.

pages.title: Recovery
pages.text: Repair the opening, then wait about $(bold)5 loaded seconds$() with a connected Core or Blast Pit.$(br2)Its heat runs through a breach; its oxygen doesn't.

Replacing one block or reloading doesn't refill the room. Breaking the seal again restarts recovery.$(br2)Relight torches and lanterns with flint and steel once air returns. Campfires and candles relight normally.

pages.title: Notices
pages.text: $(bold)BREACH SEALED — RESTORING AIR$(): oxygen returning$(br)$(bold)OXYGEN SUPPLY REQUIRED$(): no source$(br)$(bold)ATMOSPHERE RESTORED$(): breathable, soft tone$(br2)$(danger)Stay on EVA until restored.$()
Restored means air, not warmth or patched suits.$(br2)Notices show in an EVA helmet HUD, or above the hotbar, never in chat. Loss is red.$(br2)$(flavor)Keep the atmosphere on the inside.$()
